meta.quiz_name: ICAO-第六章 紧急情况通话术语

questions.content: The air conditioning system has malfunctioned.
questions.trans: 空调系统已故障。

questions.content: We have only one air conditioning pack operational. Request a new cruising level below FL300.
questions.trans: 我们仅有一个空调组件运行。请求新的巡航高度低于高度300。

questions.content: All our air conditioning packs have malfunctioned. Request rapid descent to MEA .
questions.trans: 我们全部的空调组件已故障。请求快速下降到最低航路高度。

questions.content: We had a malfunction of one air conditioning pack. Request descent to a lower level.
questions.trans: 我们有一个空调组件故障。请求下降到较低高度。

questions.content: We have lost electrical power to the cabin air compressor. Request immediate descent to 10,000 feet.
questions.trans: 我们的客舱空气压缩机失去电源。请求立即下降到10000英尺。

questions.content: We just had a smoke emergency. We need to depressurize the airplane to let in fresh air. Request rapid descent to 8000 feet.
questions.trans: 我们刚发生烟雾紧急状况。需要释压让新鲜空气进入飞机。请求快速下降到8000英尺。

questions.content: We have unusual smell from air conditioning packs. Request stop climb at 7000 feet.
questions.trans: 空调组件出现异常气味。请求在7000英尺，停止爬升。

questions.content: Many passengers are suffering from smoke inhalation. Request medical assistance on arrival.
questions.trans: 许多旅客遭受烟尘吸入。请求到达时医疗救助。

questions.content: Our pressurization system has malfunctioned.
questions.trans: 我们的增压系统故障。

questions.content: We have difficulty in controlling the cabin pressure.
questions.trans: 我们控制座舱增压有难度。

questions.content: We have a cabin altitude problem.
questions.trans: 我们座舱高度有问题。

questions.content: Our cabin rate of climb has red-lined. Request immediate descent.
questions.trans: 我们座舱上升率已达到红线。请求立即下降。

questions.content: We have a slow cabin decompression. Request immediate descent.
questions.trans: 我们座舱慢释压，请求立即下降。

questions.content: Our cabin altitude at one time had reached 16000 feet. Some passengers have symptoms of hypoxia.
questions.trans: 我们的座舱高度曾达到了16000英尺。部分旅客有缺氧症状。

questions.content: We are now depressurized and will fly a more shallow descent profile.
questions.trans: 我们现在释压飞行，需要更平缓的下降剖面。

questions.content: Request descent rate less than 500 feet per minute due to unpressurized cabin.
questions.trans: 由于客舱失压，请求下降率小于每分钟500英尺。

questions.content: We are now ventilating with ram air. It is best that our rate of descent does not exceed 600 feet per minute.
questions.trans: 我们现在通过冲压空气通风，我们下降率最好不超过每分钟600英尺.

questions.content: We have a problem with the avionics ventilation system.
questions.trans: 我们的电子通风系统有问题。

questions.content: We have an avionics ventilation problem. The skin heat-exchangers and blower fan have failed.
questions.trans: 我们的电子通风有问题。蒙皮热交换器和吹风扇都故障了。

questions.content: The avionics ventilation is unserviceable. Request diversion to the closest suitable airport.
questions.trans: 电子舱通风故障。请求备降到就近合适机场。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: We have severe vibration coming from the avionics ventilation fan.
questions.trans: 我们的电子通风风扇严重抖振。

questions.content: There are unusual noises coming from the avionics bay.
questions.trans: 电子设备舱有异常噪音。

questions.content: Our FMS has malfunctioned. Request radar vectors.
questions.trans: 我们的飞行管理系统故障了，请求雷达引导。

questions.content: Request further climb due wind-shear.
questions.trans: 由于风切变，申请进一步爬升。

questions.content: Unable to maintain altitude, request leaving RVSM airspace.
questions.trans: 不能保持高度，申请离开RVSM空域。

questions.content: We cannot make RNP approach due equipment.
questions.trans: 由于设备，我们不再符合RNP进近。

questions.content: Our navigation accuracy is low. Request to climb to minimum safe altitude.
questions.trans: 我们的导航精度低。请求上升到最低安全高度。

questions.content: We have a navigation map shift, unable to perform the RNAV approach. Request radar vectors.
questions.trans: 我们有导航地图漂移，无法飞RNAV进近。申请雷达引导。

questions.content: Inertial reference system has failed. We are navigating on raw data. Request conventional approach.
questions.trans: 惯导失效了，我们正在使用原始导航，申请传统进近。

questions.content: The Morse code for the VOR is different from the approach chart. Confirm the VOR is fully operational.
questions.trans: VOR的莫尔斯代码与我们进近图上的不一致。证实VOR台在运行中。

questions.content: The ILS signal seems to be very unstable. Did any other pilot report a similar situation?
questions.trans: 盲降信号不稳定，其他飞行员报告过类似情况吗？

questions.content: The approach lights for Runway 36L are a bit different from those shown on the airport diagram.
questions.trans: 36左跑道的进近灯光与机场图上的显示有点不同。

questions.content: The flight path is unstable. Going around.
questions.trans: 飞行轨迹不稳定。复飞了。

questions.content: We made a missed approach due to unstable ILS signals.
questions.trans: 由于盲降信号不稳定，我们执行了复飞。

questions.content: The ILS signal was unstable. Request approach to another runway or request another type of approach.
questions.trans: 盲降信号不稳定。申请换一条跑道进近，或申请另一种进近方式。

questions.content: The DME indication is not correct. Confirm the DME is still in service.
questions.trans: DME显示不对。证实DME还在运行中。

questions.content: We have lost our flight plan after a flight management computer reset.
questions.trans: 我们复位了飞行管理计算机后丢失了飞行计划。

questions.content: We need a few minutes to reprogram the flight management computers. Request radar vectors.
questions.trans: 我们需要几分钟重新输程序到飞行管理计算机，申请雷达引导。

questions.content: We need to reconfigure the flight management computers for approach. Request holding instructions.
questions.trans: 我们需要重新设置飞行管理计算机，申请等待指令。

questions.content: We are now flying with basic navigation due to systems failure. Request radar vectors.
questions.trans: 由于系统故障，我们现在使用基本导航飞行。申请雷达引导。

questions.content: We have multiple failures on the inertial reference system. We are no longer able to fly oceanic route. Request return for landing.
questions.trans: 我们有多个惯导失效，我们不能再跨洋飞行，申请返场着陆。

questions.content: We do not meet GPS approach requirement due to flight crew qualifications.
questions.trans: 由于机组资格，我们不符合GPS进近要求。

questions.content: Our Airline policy does not allow us to perform CAT IIIC approach.
questions.trans: 我们公司政策不允许我们执行IIIC类进近。

questions.content: Our operations manual forbids this procedure.
questions.trans: 我们的运行手册禁止该程序。

questions.content: Our Aviation Authority does not permit this procedure.
questions.trans: 我们航空当局不允许该程序。

questions.content: We are unable to conform to the noise abatement procedure due performance.
questions.trans: 由于性能，我们不遵守降噪程序。

questions.content: We are not qualified for CAT IIIB approach and auto-land. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 我们不具备IIIB类进近和自动着陆资格。请求改航。

questions.content: Our VHF number One receiver has failed. We are no longer monitoring 121.5.
questions.trans: 我们第一部甚高频接收机失效，我们不再监听121.5。

questions.content: All stations, transmitting blind due to receiver failure.
questions.trans: 各台注意，由于接收机失效，正在盲发。

questions.content: All of our VHF transmitters have failed, now transmitting on HF radio. Please respond.
questions.trans: 我们所有甚高频发射机都失效了，现在高频无线电发报，请回复。

questions.content: Our SELCAL has malfunctioned. We will continue monitoring your frequency.
questions.trans: 我们的选择呼叫失效了，我们会继续监听频率。

questions.content: We are receiving an ELT signal on 121.5.
questions.trans: 我们在121.5里听到一个紧急定位发射机信号。

questions.content: We are picking up a broadcast signal on 121.5.
questions.trans: 有人在121.5里发射信号。

questions.content: Our satellite phone is unserviceable. We are unable to call company operations.
questions.trans: 我们的卫星电话今天不工作，我们联系不上公司签派。

questions.content: Our data-link has malfunctioned. Request re-release the flight plan by voice.
questions.trans: 我们数据链故障了，申请口头式的二次放行飞行计划。

questions.content: Our data-link has malfunctioned. Request ATC clearance by voice.
questions.trans: 我们的数据链故障了，申请口头式的ATC放行许可。

questions.content: My apologies, I wasn’t aware the boom mike was transmitting.
questions.trans: 不好意思，我没发觉手持话筒在发射。

questions.content: Sorry for blocking the frequency due microphone jammed.
questions.trans: 抱歉由于麦克风卡阻堵塞了通信频率。

questions.content: We have an electrical failure.
questions.trans: 我们有一个电气故障。

questions.content: One of our generators has failed. At present moment, we are still able to continue to our destination.
questions.trans: 我们一部发电机故障了。目前看来，还能够继续飞往目的地。

questions.content: Request diversion to the nearest suitable airport due AC BUS failure.
questions.trans: 我们一个交流汇流条故障了，申请备降到最近合适机场。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: We are not supplying power to our DC BUS. Request priority landing.
questions.trans: 我们不再为直流汇流条供电，申请优先落地。

questions.content: We have a problem with the aircraft battery. Request priority landing.
questions.trans: 我们飞机电瓶有问题。申请优先落地。

questions.content: One of our transformers has failed. I’ll let you know if a diversion is required.
questions.trans: 我们一个变压整流器故障了。如果需要备降我会第一时间告诉你。

questions.content: Electrical system has a serious malfunction. Request radar vectors to an airport that’s within 20 minutes of flight time.
questions.trans: 电力设备有严重故障。申请雷达引导到20分钟以内能够飞到的机场。

questions.content: We are operating with only the emergency generator. Request track direct to final, Runway 26.
questions.trans: 我们能够使用的只有紧急发电机。申请直飞五边，跑道26号。

questions.content: We are flying with batteries only. Is there any airport available within 25 minutes of flying?
questions.trans: 我们仅依靠电瓶飞行。有没有25分钟之内能够飞到的可用机场？

questions.content: If there is no airport within 100 miles, we have to make a forced landing.
questions.trans: 如果100海里范围内没有机场，我们必须迫降。

questions.content: We have less than 10 minutes of battery power left. We are preparing for ditching procedure.
questions.trans: 我们的电瓶电源供电不足10分钟，我们正在准备水上迫降程序。

questions.content: We have switched off most of our electrical systems for smoke procedure. Request vectors for a long final, Runway 15.
questions.trans: 为了排烟程序，我们关掉了大部分电气系统。申请引导到长五边，跑道15号。

questions.content: We have cut off the electrical system to the cabin and the onboard fire is under control.
questions.trans: 我们已经切断了到客舱的电气系统，机上火情得到了控制。

questions.content: We had an electrical fire from the galley, now extinguished. Request return to land.
questions.trans: 我们有厨房电气火警，现在已经熄灭。请求返场着陆。

questions.content: There was a fire from the avionics bay. Request radar vectors for final.
questions.trans: 电子设备舱有火警。请求雷达引导到五边。

questions.content: We have had a bird strike. Our windshield has cracked.
questions.trans: 我们遭遇鸟击，风挡出现裂痕。

questions.content: The windshield suddenly had electrical arcing. We need to pull the circuit breakers and delay the approach.
questions.trans: 风挡突然出现电弧，我们需要拨跳开关并推迟进近。

questions.content: The cockpit side window is not sealed properly. Request reduce to minimum speed and descend to 4000 feet.
questions.trans: 驾驶舱侧窗没关好，申请减速到最小速度，下降到4000英尺。

questions.content: We had to go around due pilot seat moving. We’ll try to reset the circuit breaker before making another approach.
questions.trans: 刚才复飞是由于驾驶员座椅自己移动了，我们得先试着复位椅子的跳开关再进近。

questions.content: We have already discharged the engine extinguishers. The fire warning light is still on. Do you have a visual on our left engine?
questions.trans: 我们已经释放了发动机灭火瓶，火警灯仍然亮。你们能目视看看我们的左发是否有火？

questions.content: We cannot extinguish the engine fire. Request priority landing and emergency services on arrival.
questions.trans: 我们不能熄灭发动机火情。申请优先落地和到场时的紧急服务。

questions.content: We have an APU fire warning. Can you verify if there is smoke coming from the back of the plane?
questions.trans: 我们有APU火警。你能否看到我们飞机后部是否有烟雾？

questions.content: The APU fire seems to be extinguished. Request fire trucks on standby and stairs vehicle to disembark the passengers.
questions.trans: APU火情看样子被熄灭了，申请消防车待命，还有客梯车以便让旅客下飞机。

questions.content: The APU is still on fire. We are evacuating. Request emergency services.
questions.trans: APU火还在燃烧，我们现在紧急撤离，申请紧急服务。

questions.content: We had a cargo smoke warning. Advise the ground handlers NOT to open our cargo door until the passengers have all disembarked.
questions.trans: 我们有个货舱烟雾警告。请告知地面装卸人员在所有旅客下飞机之前千万别打开货舱门。

questions.content: A passenger ignited the lavatory waste bin. Advise the airport police to await our arrival.
questions.trans: 一名旅客点燃了盥洗室垃圾桶。告知机场警察到场来处理。

questions.content: We have smoke coming out of our avionics bay. It is out of control. Request proceed direct to final and cancel all speed restrictions.
questions.trans: 我们有烟雾来自我们的电子设备舱。已经失控了。申请直飞五边并取消全部速度限制。

questions.content: We have smoke coming from our avionics bay. We are evacuating. Request fire trucks.
questions.trans: 我们有烟雾来自我们的电子设备舱。我们正在紧急撤离。申请消防车。

questions.content: We have smoke coming from our avionics bay. We are disembarking the passengers.
questions.trans: 我们有烟雾来自我们的电子设备舱，我们正在让旅客离机。

questions.content: Request descent to 10000 feet to ventilate the aircraft due smoke.
questions.trans: 由于烟雾，请求下降到10000 英尺使飞机得到通风。

questions.content: We have emptied most of our fire extinguishers, but the cabin fire is still on.
questions.trans: 我们已经释放了灭火瓶，但客舱火警仍然存在。

questions.content: We are having flight control problems.
questions.trans: 我们有飞行操纵问题。

questions.content: Our flight control computers are not functioning well. We are having difficulty maintaining level flight, unable RVSM.
questions.trans: 我们飞行操作计算机工作不太理想，我们保持平飞有些困难，不能在RVSM空域飞行。

questions.content: Our pitch control has malfunctioned. We cannot move the elevators. We are flying the airplane with only trim.
questions.trans: 我们俯仰控制失效了，升降舵动不了，我们尝试用配平来控制飞机。

questions.content: The aircraft has a tendency to roll to the right. I need additional airspace to maneuver.
questions.trans: 飞机有向右横滚的趋势，我需要更多的的空域来机动。

questions.content: We have finished the checklist but still cannot retract some of the speed brakes. Request the longest runway for landing.
questions.trans: 我们完成了检查单但还是不能收回一部分减速板。申请最长的跑道落地。

questions.content: We cannot fully extend the flaps. Request the longest runway for landing.
questions.trans: 我们不能完全放出襟翼，申请最长的跑道落地。

questions.content: We have asymmetric flaps. Airplane is rolling to the left. Request holding to solve the problem.
questions.trans: 我们的襟翼位置不对称，飞机向左横滚，请求等待以解决问题。

questions.content: Request high speed approach. Part of our flight control surfaces have separated from the wing.
questions.trans: 请求大速度进近。部分飞机操作面与机翼分离。

questions.content: Request immediate climb above the minimum safe altitude to perform the checklist due to run-away trim condition.
questions.trans: 由于配平失控，申请立即上安全高度以上来做检查单。

questions.content: Request vectors for long final. We are controlling the airplane with mechanical backup.
questions.trans: 请求雷达引导到长五边。我们正用机械备用设备操作飞机。

questions.content: Request return to FL250.We just had an air-upset situation and lost a lot of altitude.
questions.trans: 申请回到高度250，我们刚才有空中异常姿态的情况，而且掉了很多高度。

questions.content: We have a problem with yaw damping. The aircraft is oscillating severely. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 我们偏航阻尼出现问题，飞机摇摆很严重，申请备降。

questions.content: We have lost electrical power to some of the flight control actuators. Request delay our descent to perform checklist.
questions.trans: 我们的一些飞机操纵作动筒失去了电源。申请延迟下降来做检查单。

questions.content: Some of our fuel pumps have low pressure. Request descent.
questions.trans: 一些燃油泵低压。请求下降。

questions.content: We have a problem with fuel temperature. Request holding position on the taxiway.
questions.trans: 我们的燃油温度有问题。请求滑行道上原地等待。

questions.content: We are leaking fuel slowly. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 我们有慢速漏油。申请改航。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: We have a severe fuel leak situation, unable to reach the closest airport. You can expect us to make a forced landing near our present location.
questions.trans: 我们有严重漏油情况，无法抵达最近的机场，估计会在我们当前位置附近地点做紧急迫降。

questions.content: Our cabin crew reports that we have fuel leak from the right wing. Request diversion to the closest suitable airport.
questions.trans: 我们客舱乘务员报告说右机翼漏油，申请飞往最近合适机场备降。

questions.content: We have already shut down engine Number One, but it is still leaking fuel near the pylon. Request emergency services.
questions.trans: 我们已经关了一发，但发动机吊架附近仍然在漏油。申请紧急服务。

questions.content: The ground crew reports that we are leaking a bit of fuel from the bottom of the right engine nacelle. We are delaying taxi.
questions.trans: 地面人员（机务）报告我们右发吊舱下方有漏燃油，我们延迟滑行。

questions.content: We need to continue to run the engines at our present location for a few minutes, will advise you shortly.
questions.trans: 我们需要在当前位置让发动机运转几分钟，将很快告知你们。

questions.content: The ground crew reports that we are leaking a significant amount of fuel from the bottom of Number Three engine. We have just shut it down.
questions.trans: 地面人员（机务）报告我们三发下方有大量燃油泄漏，我们刚刚关车了。

questions.content: The fuel leak has stopped. But if a fire starts at any time, I will order an evacuation.
questions.trans: 漏油停止了。但如果任何时候有火警，我将发布紧急撤离指令。

questions.content: We have leaked a large amount of fuel onto the apron. Request fire trucks on standby and the stairs vehicle to disembark the passengers.
questions.trans: 我们已经有大量燃油漏到了机坪。申请消防车待命和客梯车让旅客离机。

questions.content: We might have a fuel leak near the wing root. Request fire trucks on arrival.
questions.trans: 翼根可能存在漏油，申请消防车到场。

questions.content: We have fumes in the cabin, possibly due to a fuel leak. We are anticipating an immediate evacuation after landing.
questions.trans: 我们客舱有燃油味道，可能是漏油了。我们预计会在落地后立刻做紧急撤离。

questions.content: We are evacuating. Advise emergency personnel that fuel odors are still present in the cabin.
questions.trans: 我们正在紧急撤离。请告诉地面人员机上仍然有燃油味道。

questions.content: We are too heavy for landing. Request fuel-dump at the fuel dumping area.
questions.trans: 我们返场落地重量会太重。申请去放油区域放油。

questions.content: Request climb for dumping fuel and vectors to the fuel dump zone.
questions.trans: 申请上升高度放油，申请雷达引导到放油区域。

questions.content: We need about 18 minutes to jettison fuel before coming in for the approach.
questions.trans: 我们在进近前需要大概18分钟放油。

questions.content: We cannot shut off the fuel dump valve. Request radar vectors for short final, Runway 17.
questions.trans: 我们无法关断放油活门，申请雷达引导到短五边，跑道17。

questions.content: We are indicating fuel filter clog. Request descent and to maintain high speed.
questions.trans: 我们显示有燃油过滤阻塞，申请下降并保持大速度。

questions.content: Our left engine failed due to fuel starvation.
questions.trans: 由于没有燃油供给，我们的左发失效。

questions.content: We are near the freezing temperature of jet fuel. Request descent to FL 390.
questions.trans: 我们接近燃油的冰点温度，申请下降到高度390。

questions.content: We suspect there is contamination in our fuel tanks.
questions.trans: 我们怀疑油箱里的燃油被污染了。

questions.content: One of our hydraulic systems has exceeded temperature limits.
questions.trans: 我们的一个液压系统超温。

questions.content: We have shut down one of the hydraulic systems.
questions.trans: 我们已经关掉了一个液压系统。

questions.content: The backup hydraulic system is operational but we still want to divert.
questions.trans: 备用液压系统在工作，但我们仍然要备降。

questions.content: Our hydraulic systems have a malfunction. Request descent to lower levels to extend flaps in advance.
questions.trans: 我们的液压系统有个故障。请求下降到较低高度以便放出襟翼。

questions.content: Our hydraulic fluid is dangerously low, possibly due to a leak. Request descent to lower levels to extend flaps.
questions.trans: 我们的液压油低得可怕，可能漏油。请求下降到低高度放出襟翼。

questions.content: Two of our hydraulic systems have failed. Request immediate diversion.
questions.trans: 我们有两个液压系统失效，申请立即备降。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: Our ram air turbine is not providing any hydraulic pressure. We are still operating on one hydraulic system only. Request diversion to the nearest suitable airport.
questions.trans: 我们的冲压空气涡轮没有提供任何液压压力。我们仍然还是单套液压系统运行，申请到附近合适机场备降。

questions.content: Request the longest runway and vectors for a wide downwind due to hydraulic failure.
questions.trans: 由于液压失效，请求最长的跑道和雷达引导到宽的三边。

questions.content: We still have only one hydraulic system. Request the longest runway for landing.
questions.trans: 我们仍然有一套液压系统。申请最长的跑道着陆。

questions.content: Our left engine anti-ice system has failed. Request immediate climb to leave the icing area.
questions.trans: 我们的左发防冰系统故障，申请立即上升来脱离结冰区域。

questions.content: We must descend immediately to exit icing conditions. Our right engine bleed air has failed.
questions.trans: 我们必须立即下降脱离结冰条件。我们的右发引气已失效。

questions.content: Both our windshield heating systems have failed. Ice is obstructing our view. Request latest airport weather.
questions.trans: 我们风挡加温系统故障了，冰挡住了我们的视线。申请最新的机场天气。

questions.content: We had electrical arcing on the windshield and pulled the circuit breakers according to the checklist. Will advise when ready for approach.
questions.trans: 我们的风挡刚才有电弧，根据检查单我们拨了跳开关。我们准备好进近时将告知你们。

questions.content: We performed the missed approach because my windshield wiper became inoperative and I could not see very well.
questions.trans: 我们执行了复飞是因为我的风挡雨刷坏了，我刚才无法看清楚了。

questions.content: Our pitot static heating system has failed. We might have an altitude error.
questions.trans: 我们皮托管静压口加温系统故障了，我们可能有高度误差。

questions.content: We made the overshoot because of a stall warning, probably caused by a defective angle of attack probe.
questions.trans: 我们复飞是因为失速警告，可能是迎角探头有故障。

questions.content: I had to abort takeoff because I didn’t receive any airspeed indication.
questions.trans: 我必须中断起飞，因为我没有看到任何空速指示。

questions.content: We have an error in our airspeed. Request to climb to minimum safe altitude.
questions.trans: 我们的空速有误差。申请上升到最低安全高度以上。

questions.content: We have master warning lights in the cockpit. Request landing at the nearest suitable airport.
questions.trans: 我们的驾驶舱主警告灯亮了。申请就近合适机场着陆。

questions.content: We have a master caution. I will notify you if a diversion is required.
questions.trans: 我们有一个主警告灯亮了。如需备降，我将告知。

questions.content: Some of our instruments are not indicating correctly. Request level off to perform checklist.
questions.trans: 一些仪表不能正确显示，申请改平飞执行检查单。

questions.content: Two of our display units have failed. We are no longer RNP qualified. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 我们的两个显示屏故障。我们不再具备RNP资格。申请备降。

questions.content: We made the go around due to navigation accuracy downgrade.
questions.trans: 我们复飞是因为导航精度降低。

questions.content: We made the go around due to FMS position error.
questions.trans: 我们复飞是因为飞行管理计算机误差。

questions.content: We made the go around due to map drift on our navigation display.
questions.trans: 我们复飞是因为导航显示上地图漂移。

questions.content: We made the go around due to GPS error.
questions.trans: 我们复飞是因为GPS误差。

questions.content: We made the go around due to lateral deviation exceedance.
questions.trans: 我们复飞是因为横向偏离超出限制。

questions.content: We made the go around due to CDU failure.
questions.trans: 我们复飞是因为CDU故障。

questions.content: We made the go around because we exceeded the vertical deviation limit.
questions.trans: 我们复飞是因为我们超出了纵向偏离限制。

questions.content: We no longer have altitude warning. Request leaving RVSM airspace.
questions.trans: 我们不再具备高度偏离的警告，申请离开RVSM空域。

questions.content: We have autopilot disconnection. We are no longer RVSM qualified. Request leaving RVSM airspace.
questions.trans: 我们自动驾驶脱开了，我们不再符合RVSM资质，申请离开RVSM空域。

questions.content: Our landing capability has degraded. Request terminate our approach.
questions.trans: 我们的着陆能力（类别）降级。申请终止进近。

questions.content: Request to climb to minimum safe altitude due to malfunction of navigation computers.
questions.trans: 由于导航计算机故障，申请爬升到最低安全高度。

questions.content: We performed the go-around because we had a ground proximity warning.
questions.trans: 我们复飞是因为我们出现了近地警告。

questions.content: We have conflicting traffic at one o’clock, 6 miles, descending. Request heading 130 for avoidance.
questions.trans: 我们显示冲突飞机在我们1点钟方位，6海里处，正在下降。申请航向130来避开。

questions.content: We have conflicting traffic at eleven o’clock, 8 miles, climbing. Request vectors for avoidance.
questions.trans: 我们显示冲突飞机在我们11点钟方位，8海里处，正在上升。申请雷达引导来避开。

questions.content: Traffic at our twelve o’clock, 10 miles, climbing. Should we expedite our descent to cross altitudes?
questions.trans: 冲突飞机在我们12点钟方位，10海里处，正在上升。我们应该加速下降穿越高度吗？

questions.content: Unable, TCAS RA.
questions.trans: 不能，TCASRA。

questions.content: We are clear of conflict. Request further instructions.
questions.trans: 我们解除冲突了。请求进一步指令。

questions.content: About twenty passengers and crew members were injured during the TCAS maneuver. Request diversion and medical assistance on arrival.
questions.trans: 大约20名旅客和机组人员在做机动时受伤了。申请备降和医疗援助到场。

questions.content: We are having abnormal engine indications. Request to reduce speed to 250 knots.
questions.trans: 我们显示不正常的发动机参数。申请调速到250节。

questions.content: Our engine parameters are unstable. Request stop climb at FL220.
questions.trans: 我们的发动机参数不稳定。申请在高度220时停止爬升。

questions.content: Our oil pressure reading is lower than normal. Request hold at present position.
questions.trans: 我们滑油压力读数比正常要低。请求在当前位置等待。

questions.content: The oil temperature is higher than normal. We are monitoring other engine parameters.
questions.trans: 我们滑油温度比正常的要高。我们正在监控其他发动机参数。

questions.content: Engine indicates high EGT at idle power setting. We need to have partial thrust in the descent. Request an early descent.
questions.trans: 发动机显示我们的油门收到慢车时EGT较高。我们需要带部分推力下降。申请提前下降。

questions.content: We are reading high engine vibration. Request to delay takeoff.
questions.trans: 我们的发动机读数有较高的抖振。请求延迟起飞。

questions.content: Cabin altitude is increasing abnormally. Request to level off.
questions.trans: 客舱高度显示增加异常。请求改平飞。

questions.content: Our instruments indicate excessive high cabin altitude.
questions.trans: 我们的仪表显示客舱高度过高。

questions.content: Our instrument indicates abnormal cabin pressure differential.
questions.trans: 我们仪表显示不正常的客舱压差。

questions.content: Our fuel endurance is 48 minutes. We must leave the hold otherwise we will be at minimum fuel.
questions.trans: 我们燃油续航时间是48分钟。我们必须离开等待，否则我们将出现最低燃油。

questions.content: Cockpit oxygen cylinder pressure is low. Request to return for landing.
questions.trans: 驾驶舱氧气瓶显示低压力，申请返场着陆。

questions.content: We are holding at present position. It appears one of the over-wing exits has unlocked.
questions.trans: 我们在原地等待。好像机翼上方的一个出口松锁。

questions.content: It seems some of the spoilers cannot be retracted. We have to re-calculate our landing distance before we start our approach, standby.
questions.trans: 似乎一部分扰流板不能收回，我们重新计算一下着陆距离才能进近，稍等。

questions.content: We have an indication that the nose wheel did not extend properly. Request low pass for visual check.
questions.trans: 我们仪表显示前轮没有正常放出。申请低空通场目视检查。

questions.content: We have lost our braking. We used thrust reversers to stop the aircraft. Request ground services to chock the nose wheel.
questions.trans: 我们失去了刹车，刚才用反推来停住飞机，申请地面服务用销子挡好前轮。

questions.content: Our brakes have seized. The tyres might burst during touchdown. Request fire trucks on arrival.
questions.trans: 我们的刹车卡死了。可能接地时轮胎会爆胎。申请消防车到场。

questions.content: We made the go-around because our landing gear wouldn't extend normally. Request holding pattern to perform checklist.
questions.trans: 我们刚才复飞的原因是起落架无法正常放出。申请等待来做检查单。

questions.content: We have exhausted all options. We will land without the nose gear fully locked.
questions.trans: 我们用尽了所有选项。现在只能够尝试没有前起落架完全锁住的情况下落地。

questions.content: We cannot extend the left landing gear. Request foaming the runway.
questions.trans: 我们不能放出左起落架。申请在跑道上喷洒泡沫。

questions.content: Request diversion to a nearby airport with foaming capability.
questions.trans: 申请备降到附近一个能够喷洒防火泡沫的机场。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: We applied maximum braking when we rejected takeoff. Request fire services to escort the aircraft back to the apron.
questions.trans: 刚才中断起飞时我们使用了最大刹车。申请消防车护送飞机回停机坪。

questions.content: The tyres are deflated. We will have to hold at present position for maintenance inspection.
questions.trans: 轮胎瘪了，我们需要原地等待机务来做检查。

questions.content: I think we blew a nose wheel tyre. Request holding position.
questions.trans: 我认为我们的前轮爆胎了。申请原地等待。

questions.content: We no longer have airspeed and altitude on our primary displays.
questions.trans: 我们的主显示器上不再有空速和高度显示了。

questions.content: We have errors with our navigation. Request radar monitoring.
questions.trans: 我们的导航有误差。申请雷达监控。

questions.content: Our inertial reference system has failed, unable GPS approach. Request ILS or VOR approach.
questions.trans: 我们的惯导失效了，不能够使用GPS进近。申请盲降或VOR进近。

questions.content: We made the go around because the GPWS warning was triggered.
questions.trans: 我们复飞是因为触发了近地警告。

questions.content: We have to recalibrate our instruments. Request to level off and maintain heading.
questions.trans: 我们需要重新校准仪表。申请改平飞并保持航向。

questions.content: Our ADS-B transmitter appears to be malfunctioning. Terminating further ADS-B transmissions.
questions.trans: 我们的ADS-B发报机似乎故障了。终止ADS-B发报。

questions.content: ADS-B equipment degradation, will advise when able to resume operations.
questions.trans: ADS-B设备降级，当恢复使用时将告知。

questions.content: GPS unreliable, terminating ADS-B transmissions.
questions.trans: GPS不可靠，终止ADS-B发报。

questions.content: Our ADS-B has malfunctioned. Is there any weather advisory at our destination?
questions.trans: 我们的ADS-B发报机已故障。有目的地机场的气象报吗？

questions.content: We made an overshoot because our ADS-B indicated a possible runway incursion.
questions.trans: 我们复飞是因为我们的ADS-B显示可能有跑道入侵。

questions.content: We made a go-around due to head-up display problem. We’ll inform you when we are ready for the approach.
questions.trans: 我们复飞是因为平显故障。准备好进近时我们将通知你们。

questions.content: Our airspeed is unreliable. Request climb to minimum safe altitude to perform checklist.
questions.trans: 我们的空速指示不可靠。申请爬升到最低安全高度来做检查单。

questions.content: Our airspeed is unreliable. Request radar vectors for long final.
questions.trans: 我们的空速指示不可靠，请求雷达引导到长五边。

questions.content: We made the go-around because the radio altimeter triggered flare mode.
questions.trans: 我们复飞的原因是因为无线电高度表诱发了拉平方式。

questions.content: Our weather radar has failed and we are in IMC. Request return for landing.
questions.trans: 我们气象雷达失效，我们仪表气象条件飞行。申请返场落地。

questions.content: Our weather radar has malfunctioned. What is the highest available level for cruise?
questions.trans: 我们气象雷达故障。最高可用的巡航高度是多少？

questions.content: Our weather radar has failed. How did the preceding aircraft deviate from the weather?
questions.trans: 我们气象雷达坏了。前机都怎么绕飞的？

questions.content: We do not have that route in our database. Which heading should we maintain for now？
questions.trans: 我们数据库没有这个航路。我们现在应该保持哪个航向？

questions.content: We do not have that runway in our database. Request delay our descent while we program the CDU.
questions.trans: 我们数据库里没有这条跑道。我们需要输入CDU，申请延迟下降。

questions.content: We have a navigation malfunction. Request diversion to a suitable airport that has less complex terrain.
questions.trans: 我们有导航故障。申请备降到就近的较少复杂地形的机场。

questions.content: Our oxygen pressure is dropping rapidly. Request to fly heading 050 and descent to FL180 to escape from the mountainous area.
questions.trans: 我们的氧气压力快速下降。申请航向飞050，下降到高度180以避开山区。

questions.content: The NOTAM says the ILS is unserviceable, but we are still picking up the Morse Code, confirm it is still in operation.
questions.trans: 航行通告说盲降不工作，但我们仍然收到了莫尔斯代码，证实盲降仍然可用。

questions.content: We have an engine failure. Following ETOPS procedure, request descent to FL200, maintain high speed and proceed direct to alternate airport.
questions.trans: 我们发动机故障了。按照ETOPS程序，申请下降高度200，保持大速度直飞备降场。

questions.content: We cannot provide oxygen to the passengers as we are not sure where the smoke is coming from.
questions.trans: 我们不能给乘客提供氧气，因为我们不确定烟雾来源。

questions.content: Many passengers have suffered from smoke inhalation. Request medical services.
questions.trans: 许多乘客已经遭受了烟雾吸入。申请医疗服务。

questions.content: There was heavy smoke in the cabin before we ventilated the aircraft. Request medical assistance for passengers after landing.
questions.trans: 我们给飞机通风前客舱有很多烟雾。申请落地后给旅客提供医疗救助。

questions.content: The aircraft is depressurized. We are descending. Confirm 10,000 feet is enough to clear terrain until we reach our alternate.
questions.trans: 飞机处在释压状态，我们正在下降。证实我们到达备降场前10000英尺是否能满足越障。

questions.content: We are no longer getting bleed air from the right engine. Request immediate descent to leave the icing area.
questions.trans: 我们不再有来自右发的引气。申请立即下降离开结冰区。

questions.content: Our APU bleed air malfunctioned during engine startup. We are calling the ground staff, standby.
questions.trans: 我们的APU引气在发动机开车时故障了。我们正在呼叫地面机务，请稍等。

questions.content: We are expediting descent to enable a windmill startup. Request further descent.
questions.trans: 我们正在加速下降，为了能够风转启动发动机。申请进一步下降。

questions.content: We are unable to restart engine number one with bleed air. Request high speed for a windmill air start.
questions.trans: 我们不能用引气启动一发。请求大速度风转启动。

questions.content: Both engine bleed air systems have failed and we are relying on APU bleed for air conditioning. Request descent to 14, 000 feet.
questions.trans: 我们发动机引气全部失效，现在依靠APU来提供空调。申请下降到14000英尺。

questions.content: We have no bleed air coming from either engines or APU. Request rapid descent to 10,000 feet.
questions.trans: 我们没有任何来自发动机或APU的引气，申请快速下降到10000英尺。

questions.content: We are leaking bleed air. Request turn right heading 095 to avoid the icing area.
questions.trans: 我们的引气正在泄漏。请求右转095以避开结冰区。

questions.content: CPDLC has malfunctioned. We are reverting to voice communication.
questions.trans: CPDLC失效。我们正在恢复语音通信。

questions.content: Disregard my last CPDLC request for climb. We have a system problem and will maintain present level for now.
questions.trans: 作废上次CPDLC上升请求。我们出现了系统问题，将保持当前高度。

questions.content: CPDLC terminated due to failure, reverting to voice communication.
questions.trans: 由于故障终止CPDLC，恢复语音通信。

questions.content: We just had an APU fire warning, and discharged the fire extinguisher, Request visual check if there is smoke coming from our tail section.
questions.trans: 我们刚刚有过APU火警，也释放了灭火瓶。请目视检查我们飞机的尾部是否有烟雾。

questions.content: Another aircraft has seen a lot of smoke coming from our APU. We are evacuating. Request emergency services.
questions.trans: 另一架飞机看见我们APU有烟雾冒出，我们在进行紧急撤离。申请紧急服务。

questions.content: We are at bay15. We have an APU fire. Request fire services.
questions.trans: 我们在15号停机位。我们有APU火警。申请灭火服务。

questions.content: We have a generator failure and cannot start our APU at this altitude. Request descent to perform APU startup.
questions.trans: 我们有一部发电机故障，在这个高度不能启动APU。申请下降来启动APU。

questions.content: A passenger has opened an over-wing emergency exit. The slide has deployed. Request to cancel our slot time.
questions.trans: 一名旅客打开了机翼紧急出口，滑梯已经放出。请求取消我们的离场时间。

questions.content: A passenger tried to unlock the cabin door in flight, the cabin crew restrained him. Request airport police on arrival.
questions.trans: 一名旅客企图在空中打开客舱门，客舱机组已经将他制服，申请落地后机场警察到场。

questions.content: We have an abnormal noise coming from one of our cabin doors. Request rapid descent to 5000 feet.
questions.trans: 我们有一个客舱门有异常噪音。申请快速下降到5000英尺。

questions.content: Smoke is coming from the cabin floor. We are performing an evacuation. All slides have been deployed.
questions.trans: 有烟雾来自客舱地板。我们正在进行撤离。滑梯已经放出。

questions.content: We had a smoke warning from the forward cargo hold. We are evacuating.
questions.trans: 我们有烟雾来自前货舱。我们正在进行撤离。

questions.content: We have a cargo smoke warning. We are disembarking passengers. Request fire services.
questions.trans: 我们有货舱烟雾警告。我们正在让旅客下飞机。请求消防服务。

questions.content: We have smoke coming from our avionics bay. Advise the fire fighters that it might be an electrical fire.
questions.trans: 我们有烟雾来自电子设备舱。请告诉消防员可能有电气火情。

questions.content: The cockpit windshield has cracked. Request descent to FL220.
questions.trans: 驾驶舱风挡裂了。请求下降高度220。

questions.content: The windshield is cracked on the outside. Request descent.
questions.trans: 风挡在外层裂了。请求下降。

questions.content: Neither of us can see through our windshield. Does your airport permit auto-land?
questions.trans: 我们和副驾驶都无法通过风挡看到外面。你机场允许自动着陆吗？

questions.content: Our thrust lever is not responsive. We cannot reduce thrust on engine Number One. Request holding.
questions.trans: 我们推力手柄反应不对，我们不能减少一发推力。请求等待。

questions.content: Our engine control has malfunctioned. We cannot get much thrust. Request immediate descent.
questions.trans: 我们的发动机控制有故障。我们不能得到较大推力。申请立即下降。

questions.content: We have a thrust reverser opened in flight. We cannot maintain this level. Request immediate descent.
questions.trans: 空中反推被放出。我们不能保持高度。请求立即下降。

questions.content: We still cannot retract the thrust reverser. Our approach speed will be higher than normal. Request vectors for the longest Runway.
questions.trans: 我们仍人不能收回反推。我们的进近速度会大于正常速度。申请雷达引导到最长的跑道落地。

questions.content: We aborted takeoff due loss of engine oil pressure.
questions.trans: 由于发动机失去了滑油压力，我们中断起飞了。

questions.content: We have an engine oil leak. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 我们有发动机滑油泄漏。申请备降。 *Note：单词diversion有两种读音方式，一种是[dɪˈvɜːʃn]，另一种是[daɪˈvɜːʃn]。

questions.content: We have a low oil pressure warning from engine Number Two. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 我们的二发有滑油压力低的警告。申请备降。

questions.content: Engine Number One has a temperature problem. Request holding to perform checklist.
questions.trans: 一号发动机有温度问题。申请等待来执行检查单。

questions.content: Our EGT continues to be above the maximum limit. Request descent. We might shut down engine Number Two shortly.
questions.trans: 我们的排气温度继续高于最大值限。申请下降。我们可能马上关掉二号发动机。

questions.content: We have performed our procedures but engine vibration still exists. Request diversion.
questions.trans: 我们已完成了程序但发动机抖振仍然存在。申请备降。

questions.content: The engine vibration is now causing the airplane to shake violently. We are shutting down our engine Number Three.
questions.trans: 现在发动机抖振引起飞机震动剧烈。我们正准备关掉三号发动机。

questions.content: We’ve made a visual inspection of engine Number Two from the cabin. The engine cowling has fallen off.
questions.trans: 我们从客舱里目视观察二号发动机。发动机整流罩脱落了。

questions.content: Engine Number Three has smoke coming out of the pylon section. We are evacuating.
questions.trans: 三号发动机吊架部位出现烟雾。我们正在撤离。

questions.content: Ground vehicle has collided with our engine nacelle. Maintenance work is needed before flight. Request cancel our airway clearance.
questions.trans: 地面车辆与发动机短舱碰撞了。飞行前需要机务维护。申请取消我们的航路许可。

questions.content: The Number Two engine has been shut down. We are no longer able to maintain level flight. Request descent to FL200.
questions.trans: 已关掉二号发动机。我们不能够保持平飞。申请下降到高度200。

questions.content: The uncontained engine failure has caused parts of the fuselage to be damaged. Request emergency descent.
questions.trans: 发动机失效是非包容性质的，已经导致部分机身损坏。申请紧急下降。

questions.content: Our left engine has ingested FOD. We are shutting down engines and holding position.
questions.trans: 我们的左发吸入了外物而损坏。我们马上关车并原地等待。

questions.content: There is a huge gaping hole in the aisle, somehow the cabin floor has been punctured. We are re-seating passengers. Request holding.
questions.trans: 过道出现很大的洞，不知怎么的，客舱地板被穿透了。我们重新安排旅客座位。申请等待。

questions.content: We have abnormal noise coming from the mid section of our fuselage, somewhere near the ceiling. Request descent and reduce speed.
questions.trans: 我们的机身中部有异常噪音，在客舱顶部附近。申请下降并减速。

questions.content: We heard an explosion from the cabin. Request to stop climb.
questions.trans: 我们听到客舱有爆炸声。申请停止上升。

questions.content: We are unsure about the cause of the explosion. There are injuries in the cabin. We’ll give you an update as soon as possible.
questions.trans: 我们不确定爆炸的原因。客舱有人受伤。我们一有新消息将尽快提供给你们。

questions.content: Some passengers have cuts and burn wounds due onboard explosion. Request diversion and medical services upon arrival.
questions.trans: 由于机上爆炸，部分旅客有割伤和烧伤。申请备降和到场时的医疗服务。
